description: This file provides utility functions for managing SQLite database connections within the backend of a project. It includes functions to extract the database file path from a configuration file and to create and configure database connections with foreign key support enabled.

methods.name: Optional[str] _extract_db_path_from_db_connection_file(contents: str)
methods.description: Parses contents of the database connection file to extract the SQLite database file path or connection string.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Reads the configuration file to determine and return the absolute path to the SQLite database.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled and row factory set for dict-like access.
